basePrompt: Use case: illustration-story. ONE original opaque full-bleed 5:7 portrait oil painting for a medieval dark-fantasy civilization Practice card. Seek the storytelling compositional mastery of N. C. Wyeth and Dean Cornwell: one decisive action, bold silhouettes, monumental environmental scale, broad expressive visible oil brushwork, large calm color masses, and the sharpest contrast only at the action. Early twentieth-century adventure book painting, not photorealistic or glossy digital fantasy. Include two or three human figures; all faces completely indiscernible, shown from behind, distant, masked by helmets, or in deep shadow. Put the action, key tool or material, and principal figures in the UPPER CENTRAL 45 percent because game UI covers the lower half. The lower half is subdued and quiet. Clear at 70x100 pixels. No text, letters, symbols, decorative border, frame, interface, vignette, tiny clutter, or unrelated objects. Subject:

assets.herdingTrain: Three cloaked warrior-herders drive a compact pale cattle herd along a vast mountain military road. The lead person raises a crook to turn one stubborn animal near a narrow gate; a distant bannerless camp only a soft shape. Huge valley and animal scale, pale cattle against dark rock focal.
assets.huntingParties: Three small hooded hunters with spears emerge from towering dark pines as one great wild boar crosses a sunlit gap. The leading hunter lowers a spear at the frozen instant, no wound or gore. Boar and spear make one sharp crossing silhouette against pale clearing; immense forest scale.
assets.rationing: At a vast shadowed army camp, three cloaked quartermasters distribute one round pale loaf from a large basket to a waiting soldier. The transfer of loaf between outstretched hands is the sole bright focal gesture. Tents and distant people dissolve into broad dark masses, no faces.
assets.smokingRations: In a high dark timber smokehouse, three faceless workers hang strips of meat on a rack over one small ember fire. The pale smoke plume and a single warm hanging strip are focal against huge black beams; the lower chamber is quiet shadow. No gore.
assets.fieldProvisioning: Three cloaked provisioners load huge grain sacks onto a military cart beneath a vast stormy sky. One pale sack is lifted across the upper center between two figures; camp tents and wagons recede as muted shapes. Strong diagonal arms and sack focal, broad earth below.
assets.packTrains: A long diagonal procession of pack horses bearing sacks crosses an immense mountain pass. Three hooded handlers appear at different depths, the lead one guiding a pale horse over a narrow stone bridge. Horse and handler silhouette are focal, cliff and valley vastly larger.
assets.warWagons: A heavy timber war wagon with broad wheels and shielded sides crests a vast muddy ridge. Three helmeted soldiers seen from behind strain at its ropes while one guides the horse. A single pale wheel rim against dark ground is focal; immense storm sky, no insignia.
assets.bowmaking: In a tall dark armory workshop, three faceless bowyers bend one long pale bow stave into shape using a rope jig. The bowed curve and taut string are the bright focal arc; spare bows in shadow are broad simple lines. Warm wood against cool slate.
assets.weaponsmithing: Three helmeted smiths forge a broad spearhead at a high stone forge. One hammer strikes the glowing blade while another braces it; a third holds a rack of finished spearheads in shadow. The single orange-white spear tip is the focal point; avoid a generic sword scene.
assets.shieldmaking: In a huge timber workshop, three faceless makers fasten a curved brass rim onto one large plain round shield. The pale shield face and joined hands are the focal circle; other shields lean as quiet dark discs, high beams create scale. No heraldry or symbols.
assets.leatherworking: Three hooded leatherworkers stretch one broad warm tan hide on a tall rectangular frame beneath a shed roof. One cuts a clean leather strap at the upper center; the light hide against dark workshop is the focal plane. No gore, simple deliberate composition.
assets.armourSmithing: In a vast dim armory forge, three faceless smiths hammer one bright steel breastplate on a broad anvil. The curved silver chest piece catches one narrow warm beam; dark armor racks and high stone vault recede. Distinct breastplate silhouette, no sword.
